implementation.snippet: Immutable text/string arrays; explicit empty copy override; prompt/copyable; canonical size and variants; Code/Scroll Area/Copy Button composition; start/end slots; one composed copy result
implementation.browser: Author-owned preview content; optional named group; escaped formatted address; decorative nonfocusable chrome; no own actions
implementation.shared: Scroll Viewport handles keys only on its own native scrolling element; physical arrows, logical RTL Home/End, page/space movement; nested input keys remain native

deviations: Snippet removes the approved retired properties/imperative copy facade; surrounding layout owns width, Theme owns appearance. The source 13px/20px text and default 42px one-line frame are retained; small is 36px.
Browser removes the approved internal copy action and its style producer. The remaining frame uses its existing generated mapping.

Plain native WebKit horizontal scroll containers did not respond to ArrowRight in this test environment, with or without shadow DOM or hidden scrollbars. Shared explicit viewport key handling supplies consistent control rather than overriding descendant keys.
